# #736 — TS client parity: session_wrap still asserts the caller's exact scope — port the lane-scope adoption from PR #732

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-18T03:27:12Z
Updated: 2026-08-18T03:27:12Z

---

PR #732 (operator-ruled, ledger item 33) changed the Python lifecycle runtime so manual wrap/checkpoint ADOPTS a hook-owned lane's stored scope, validating on session_key + namespace. clients/ts mirrors the old behavior (clients/ts/src/runtime.ts:307 — session_wrap exact-scope coordinates; validation.ts carries the same scope-proof shape), so a TS-client manual wrap against a hook-created lane still dies on the server's #646 one-way-fill refusal.

Port the adoption + retire the equivalent client-side hostile-same-namespace assertion if one exists (per the same ruling: the client cannot observe the distinction; the server namespace predicate is the boundary). Refs #724, PR #732.
